depiction_rules.notes: Recurring devotee for D003. Show physical affliction through supported posture and limited mobility while preserving dignity; his emotional arc moves from pain and pleading toward ecstatic devotion and peaceful lifelong worship.

visual_bible.age: mature adult scholar, approximately late forties to fifties
visual_bible.face: consistent oval thoughtful face, expressive dark eyes, short dark beard and moustache, vertical sandal-paste tilak
visual_bible.hair: dark hair tied in a small traditional kudumi
visual_bible.build: slender and physically afflicted but dignified, never grotesque
visual_bible.clothing: simple warm-cream Kerala dhoti and muted deep-maroon shoulder cloth, sacred thread, modest tulsi beads
visual_bible.continuity_markers: same face, beard, tilak, garment colors and body proportions in every scene

never: no royal crown or ornate jewelry
no changing beard, tilak, clothing palette or apparent age
